text: Educator
I am running to represent District 3 because residents deserve safe neighborhoods, clean streets, responsive government, and leadership that follows through.

I am an educator, parent, longtime family caregiver, and community advocate. I hold a Bachelor of Social Work and a Master of Education. These experiences have taught me to listen carefully, navigate complex systems, solve problems, and stand up for people when government is not working as it should.

My priorities are practical: improve neglected areas such as Katella Avenue; strengthen public safety through visible Sheriff patrols and better coordination among law enforcement, code enforcement, businesses, and residents; address recurring problems along Beach Boulevard; and ensure responsible development benefits the neighborhoods already here.

I will scrutinize contracts and publicly funded programs, ask who benefits, and challenge waste, conflicts of interest, and spending that does not produce measurable results. Public money should create real pathways to safety, employment, treatment, stability, and independence while protecting individual rights.

City Hall should listen, explain its decisions, and treat every resident with dignity. I am asking for your vote to bring independent judgment, practical oversight, and determined advocacy to the Stanton City Council.

text: City of Stanton Planning Commissioner

I’m running for the District 3 City Council to bring a strong, committed voice to our often overlooked neighborhoods. As a Stanton resident since 1975, I’ve dedicated my life to serving our community—six years on Parks and Recreation, current Planning Commissioner, Lions Club member, Boys & Girls Club board member, Neighborhood Watch participant, and a volunteer wherever help is needed.
In my work with Rady Children’s Health (CHOC), I helped bring the Wellness on Wheels program to Stanton, expanding medical support for children and families in our city.

Walking every block of District 3, I listened to residents and identified key concerns: homelessness, traffic and parking challenges, and the need for greater leadership transparency. These priorities will guide my work from day one.
Your voice matters. I will ensure your concerns are heard, addressed, and acted on. I will hold city leadership accountable and push for timely, meaningful solutions.
I’m ready to fight for our community and for you.

text: City of Stanton Commissioner/Supervisor
I have dedicated my professional and personal life to public service because improving the lives of others and strengthening the community is at the heart of who I am.
This is why I am running for Stanton City Council.

Professionally, I work for the Orange County Health Care Agency, where I oversee programs that provide essential services to some of our most vulnerable neighbors, people living with HIV. I advocate for underserved populations by building strong partnerships with community-based organizations.

Locally, I have the honor of serving the City of Stanton as Vice Chair of the Stanton Community Services Commission. Since my appointment, I have worked to improve our parks and recreation facilities, most notably the Stanton Central Park tennis courts.

In my neighborhood, I am my Homeowners Association’s President. In this role, I oversee the day-to-day operations, balance the annual budget, and lead efforts to identify opportunities to enhance neighborhood safety.
From countywide to citywide to my own backyard, I have a proven track record of helping those in need, ensuring fiscal responsibility, and building coalitions to advance the public good.
I hope to earn your vote so I can bring these skills to City Hall and improve the quality of life for all Stanton residents.
